statement: RL + CoT training over graph query formalisms yields only a +1.7% zero-shot gain on a downstream knowledge-graph QA benchmark, and the demonstrated transfer is cross-formalism (SQL/Cypher), not across reasoning hop depth.

evidence.quote: The model also demonstrates strong zero-shot generalization, improving performance on downstream tabular QA (TableBench: 8.5%) and knowledge graph QA (CR-LT-KGQA: 1.7%) without any QA-specific supervision.
